test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A certain sum amounts to Rs. 22,494 in 7 years at x% per annum on simple interest. If the rate of simple interest per annum had been (x + 4)%, the amount payable after 7 years would have been Rs. 25,917. Find the sum invested.
solution:
**Given:**

Rate of interest for 1st case = x%

Rate of interest for 2nd case = (x + 4)%

Time = 7 years

**Concept used:**

S.I = PTR/100

Amount = SI + P

Here

P = principal or sum

T = time

R = rate of interest

**Calculation:**

Let sum be 100a

Now,

(100a + (100a × x×7)/(100)) = Rs. 22494

⇒ 100a + 7xa = Rs. 22494 ----(i)

Again,

100a + (100a × (x+4)×7)/(100) = Rs. 25917

⇒ 100a + 7xa + 28a = Rs. 25917 ----(ii)

Putting the value of eq (i) in eq (ii) we get

22494 + 28a = 25917

⇒ 28a = 3423

⇒ a = 122.25

So, 100a = 12225 i.e the sum

**∴ The sum invested is Rs. 12225.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**Here extra interest i.e 25917 - 22494 = 3423 is for extra 4% for 7 years

So, 4% × 7 = 3423

⇒ 28% = 3423

⇒ 1% = 122.25

⇒ 100% = 12225

So, sum = Rs. 12225
